✦ Who We Are

ABOUT SPSMUN

Satpura Public School's Model United Nations brings together passionate delegates from across the country for a weekend of diplomacy, debate, and drama — 2000s style.

🌍

Global Diplomacy

Engage in real-world geopolitical issues through the lens of the most iconic decade in pop culture. Debate pressing international agendas with the energy of the 00s.

🎤

The 00's Vibe

Channel your inner pop star. Our theme — 00's Archive ft. Pop Stars — sets the stage for a conference unlike any other. Dress to impress, debate to win.

🏆

Awards & Glory

Best Delegate, Outstanding Delegate, Verbal Mention — compete for prestigious awards across all committees. Your moment of fame awaits.

🤝

Lifelong Connections

Meet delegates from schools across India, forge alliances, build friendships, and create memories that last well beyond the 00s — and this conference.

✦ The Countdown

SCHEDULE

Three days of high-octane diplomacy, 00s fashion, and unforgettable moments.

Day 01 · Opening
🎉 Opening Ceremony & Theme Launch
Red carpet welcome, Secretariat address, keynote speaker, and the official 00's Archive theme kick-off. Dress to impress.
Day 01 · Afternoon
🗣️ Committee Sessions I & II
First formal sessions across all 10 committees. Lobby, caucus, and draft your position papers.
Day 02 · Morning
📋 Committee Sessions III & IV
Deep-dive debates, draft resolutions, and the first round of crisis injections for special committees.
Day 02 · Evening
🎵 The 00's Social Night
A legendary social evening with 2000s music, pop star dress-up, and the unofficial Best Dressed Award.
Day 03 · Finale
🏆 Voting & Closing Ceremony
Final resolutions voted upon, awards announced. A closing ceremony you'll never forget — 00s style.

✦ Got Questions?

FAQ

What is the 00's Archive theme about?+
The 00's Archive theme celebrates the golden era of the 2000s — pop culture, music icons, paparazzi culture, flip phones, and that unstoppable energy. Delegates are encouraged to embrace the aesthetic in their attire and presentations.
Who can attend SPSMUN?+
SPSMUN is open to students from Grade 8 to Grade 12 from any school or institution across India. Both first-timers and experienced delegates are warmly welcome.
Do I need prior MUN experience?+
Not at all! We have committees designed for beginners and an experienced Executive Board that will guide all delegates through the process. Our pre-conference training sessions are also available.
What is the dress code?+
Formal Western or Indian attire is required for committee sessions. For the 00's Social Night, embrace your inner pop star — Y2K fashion, 2000s glam, or iconic pop star looks are strongly encouraged!
Is accommodation available?+
Yes! Outstation delegates can opt for campus accommodation at an additional cost. Details will be provided upon registration confirmation. Contact our hospitality team for assistance.
How do I contact the Secretariat?+
Reach us at spsmun@spsmun.com or via our Instagram @spsmun. Our Secretariat team typically responds within 24–48 hours.
